title: MemComposer: Learning to Assemble Memories for LLM Agents via Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.21091v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to reuse past experiences without updating their parameters. However, semantic similarity alone does not guarantee memory usefulness: downstream performance depends on how memories are selected and presented to the agent. We propose MemComposer, a memory composer that jointly examines the current query and retrieved candidates to decide which experiences to include, how many to select, and how to order them. We train the composer using Experience Policy Optimization (ExPO), a GRPO-based framework that evaluates assembled memory contexts through complete agent interactions and uses task-success feedback to optimize the assembly policy. Across three $\tau^2$-bench domains with two frozen executors, MemComposer outperforms the strongest baseline for each executor while reducing average memory-token usage by 16.9% and 4.9%, respectively. The learned policy also transfers to unseen domain

translated_title: MemComposer：通过强化学习为LLM智能体学习组装记忆
translated_abstract: 智能体记忆使大型语言模型（LLM）智能体能够在不更新参数的情况下复用过去的经验。然而，仅凭语义相似性并不能保证记忆的有用性：下游性能取决于记忆如何被选择以及如何呈现给智能体。我们提出了MemComposer，一个记忆组装器，它联合审视当前查询和检索到的候选内容，以决定包含哪些经验、选择多少条以及如何对它们排序。我们使用经验策略优化来训练该组装器，这是一个基于GRPO的框架，通过完整的智能体交互来评估组装后的记忆上下文，并利用任务成功反馈来优化组装策略。在三个τ²-bench领域中使用两个冻结的执行器进行测试，MemComposer超越了每个执行器的最强基线，同时分别将平均记忆token使用量减少了16.9%和4.9%。学习到的策略还能迁移到未见过的领域。
tldr: MemComposer提出一种基于GRPO的强化学习框架ExPO来训练记忆组装器，通过完整智能体交互的任务成功反馈，联合决定记忆的选择、数量与排序，在τ²-bench上超越最强基线的同时显著降低记忆token消耗，且策略可迁移至未见领域。
